items.slavonic_diplomatic: Что̀ тѧ̀ нарече́мъ, Ѽ бл҃года́тнаѧ? нб҃о, ꙗ҆́кѡ возсїѧ́ла є҆сѝ сл҃нце пра́вды; ра́й? ꙗ҆́кѡ прозѧбла̀ є҆сѝ цвѣ́тъ нетлѣ́нїа; Дв҃ꙋ? ꙗ҆́кѡ пребыла̀ є҆сѝ нетлѣ́нна? чи́стꙋю мт҃рь? ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆мѣ́ла є҆сѝ на ст҃ы́хъ твои́хъ ѡ҆б̾ѧ́тїихъ Сн҃а, всѣ́хъ Бг҃а: того̀ молѝ спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: What shall we name thee, O full of grace? Heaven, for thou hast shone forth the Sun of Righteousness; Paradise, for thou hast blossomed forth the Flower of incorruption; Virgin, for thou didst remain incorrupt; pure Mother, for thou hast held in thy holy arms a Son, Who is the God of all: Him do thou entreat, that our souls may be saved.

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* God shall come from Theman, and the Holy One from the mountain overshadowed and densely wooded.[^8]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ны́нѣ прⷪ҇ро́ческое прорица́нїе и҆спо́лнитисѧ грѧде́тъ, та́йнѡ глаго́лющее: и҆ ты̀ Виѳлее́ме землѐ І҆ꙋ́дова ника́коже нарече́шисѧ ме́нши во вла́кахъ, предꙋготовлѧ́ющи верте́пъ: и҆зъ тебѐ бо мнѣ̀ и҆зы́детъ во́ждь ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ во пло́ти, ѿ Дв҃ы ѻ҆трокови́цы Хрїсто́съ Бг҃ъ, и҆́же ꙋ҆пасе́тъ лю́ди своѧ̑ но́ваго І҆и҃лѧ, дади́мъ є҆мꙋ̀ всѝ вели́чїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Now the prophetic utterance draws near to its fulfillment, which secretly said: And thou Bethlehem, land of Judah, shalt by no means be called the least among the rulers, preparing the cave; for out of thee unto Me shall come forth the Ruler of the nations in the flesh, from the Virgin Maiden, Christ God, Who shall shepherd His people, the new Israel: let us all give Him majesty.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, Гла́съ г҃. Дѣ́ва дне́сь превѣ́чное сло́во, въ верте́пѣ грѧде́тъ роди́ти неизрече́ннѡ, ликꙋ́й вселе́ннаѧ ꙋ҆слы́шавши, просла́ви со а҆́гг҃лы и҆ па́стырьми, хотя́щаго, ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ, ѻ҆троча̀ мла́до превѣ́чнаго Бг҃а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3:* The Virgin this day comes to give birth ineffably in a cave unto the pre-eternal Word: rejoice, O inhabited earth, when thou hearest; glorify with the angels and the shepherds Him Who wills to appear, a young Child, the pre-eternal God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Micah, Chapter 5:*[^10]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же на всѧ́кое вре́мѧ, и҆ на всѧ́кїй ча́съ, на нб҃сѝ и҆ на землѝ, покланѧ́емый и҆ сла́вимый благі́й Бж҃е, долготерпѣли́ве, многоми́лостиве, многобл҃гоꙋтро́бне, и҆́же пра́ведныѧ любѧ́й, и҆ грѣ́шныѧ ми́лꙋѧй, всѧ̑ зовы́й ко спасенїю, ѡ҆бѣща́нїа ра́ди бꙋ́дꙋщихъ бл҃гъ. Са́мъ, Гдⷭ҇и, прїимѝ и҆ на́шѧ въ ча́съ се́й моли́твы, и҆ и҆спра́ви живо́тъ на́шъ къ за́повѣдемъ твои̑мъ. Дꙋ́шы на́шѧ ѡ҆свѧтѝ, тѣлеса̀ ѡ҆чи́сти: помышле́нїа и҆спра́ви, ра́зꙋмъ ꙋ҆цѣломꙋ́дри, и҆ и҆стрѣ́зви и҆ и҆зба́ви на́съ ѿ всѧ́кїѧ ско́рби, ѕлѡ́лъ, и҆ болѣ́зней (и҆ дꙋше́вныхъ страсте́й): ѡ҆гради́ на́съ ст҃ы́ми твои́ми а҆́гг҃лы, да ѡ҆полче́нїемъ и҆́хъ соблюда́еми, и҆ наставлѧ́е- ми, дости́гнемъ въ соединенїе вѣ́ры, и҆ въ ра́зꙋмъ непристꙋ́пныѧ твоеѧ̀ сла́вы, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ во вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́въ, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who at all times and at every hour, in heaven and on earth, art worshipped and glorified, O good God, long-suffering, plenteous in mercy, most compassionate; Who lovest the righteous and hast mercy on sinners; Who callest all men to salvation through the promise of good things to come: do Thou Thyself, O Lord, receive also our supplications at this hour, and direct our life unto Thy commandments. Sanctify our souls, purify our bodies, set aright our thoughts, cleanse our minds, make us sober, and deliver us from every tribulation, evil, and sickness (and passions of the soul); encompass us with Thy holy angels, that guarded and guided by their host, we may attain unto the unity of the faith and unto the knowledge of Thine unapproachable glory; for blessed art Thou unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ и҆ Сн҃ꙋ, и҆ ст҃о́мꙋ Дх҃ꙋ, и҆ ны́нѣ и҆ при́снѡ и҆ во вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́въ, а҆ми́нь. Честнѣ́йшꙋю херꙋвї́мъ, и҆ сла́внѣйшꙋю бе́зъ сравне́нїа Серафі́мъ, бе́зъ и҆стлѣ́нїа Бг҃а Сло́ва ро́ждшꙋю, сꙋ́щꙋю Бцⷣꙋ тѧ̀ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хрⷭ҇тѐ свѣ́те и҆́стинный, просвѣща́ѧй и҆ ѡ҆свѧща́ѧй всѧ́каго чл҃вѣ́ка грѧдꙋ́щаго въ мі́ръ, да зна́менаетсѧ на на́съ свѣ́тъ лица̀ твоегѡ̀, да въ не́мъ ꙋ҆́зримъ свѣ́тъ непристꙋ́пный, и҆ и҆спра́ви стѡпы̀ на́ша, къ дѣ́ланїю за́повѣдей твои́хъ мл҃твами пречи́стыѧ твоеѧ̀ Мт҃ре, и҆ всѣ́хъ твои́хъ ст҃ы́хъ, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Christ, the true Light, Who enlightenest and sanctifiest every man that comes into the world: let the light of Thy countenance be marked upon us, that therein we may behold the unapproachable light; and direct our steps unto the fulfilling of Thy commandments, by the prayers of Thy most pure Mother and of all Thy saints. Amen.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Micah, Chapter 5:*[^10]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Написова́шесѧ и҆ногда̀ со ста́рцемъ І҆ѡ́сифомъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ сѣ́мене Дв҃дова, во Виѳлее́мѣ Марїа́мъ, чревоносѧ́щи безсѣ́менное рожде́нїе: наста̀ же вре́мѧ рождества̀, и҆ мѣ́сто ни є҆ди́ноже бѣ̀ ѡ҆быта́лищꙋ: но ꙗ҆́коже кра́снаѧ пала́та, верте́пъ цр҃цѣ показа́шесѧ. Хрїсто́съ ражда́етсѧ, пре́жде па́дшїй воскреси́ти ѡ҆́бразъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Mary was once registered with the elder Joseph in Bethlehem as being of the seed of David, bearing in her womb the seedless conception; and the time of the birth arrived, and there was no place in the inn; but as a fair palace, the cave was shown forth to the Queen. Christ is born, to raise up the image that fell of old.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Third Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Micah, Chapter 5:*[^10]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бцⷣе, ты̀ є҆сѝ лоза̀ и҆́стиннаѧ, возрасти́вшаѧ на́мъ пло́дъ живота̀, тебѣ̀ мо́лимсѧ, моли́сѧ Влⷣчнице со ст҃ы́ми А҆пⷭ҇лы, поми́ловати дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Mother of God, thou art the true vine that didst bud forth for us the Fruit of life: thee do we entreat, pray thou, O Sovereign Lady, with the holy Apostles, that our souls may be saved.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Third Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Micah, Chapter 5:*[^10]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Се́й Бг҃ъ на́шъ, не вмѣни́тсѧ и҆́нъ къ немꙋ̀, роди́выйсѧ ѿ Дв҃ы, и҆ съ чл҃вѣ́ки поживѐ: во ꙗ҆́слѣхъ ꙋ҆бо́гихъ, Сн҃ъ є҆диноро́дный, лежа́щь ви́дитсѧ чл҃вѣ́къ: и҆ пелена́ми повива́етсѧ и҆́же сла́вы Гдⷭ҇ь, и҆ волхвѡ́мъ ѕвѣзда̀ возвѣща́етъ въ є҆гѡ̀ поклоне́нїе, и҆ мы̀ по́ймъ: Трⷪ҇це ст҃а́ѧ, спасѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: This is our God, no other shall be compared unto Him, Who was born of the Virgin and lived among men; in a humble manger the Only-Begotten Son is seen lying as a mortal man, and swaddled in swaddling clothes is the Lord of glory, and a star proclaims Him unto the Magi for His worship; and we sing: O Holy Trinity, save our souls.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Third Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Micah, Chapter 5:*[^10]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* God shall come from Theman, and the Holy One from the mountain overshadowed and densely wooded.[^17]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пре́жде рождества̀ твоегѡ̀, тре́петнѡ зрѧ́щїе та́инство твоѐ, Гдⷭ҇и, разꙋ́мнаѧ вѡ́инства дивла́хꙋсѧ, ꙗ҆́коже бо мл҃нцъ роди́тисѧ бл҃гоизво́лилъ є҆сѝ, нб҃о ꙋ҆краси́вый ѕвѣзда́ми, и҆ во ꙗ҆́слѣхъ безслове́сныхъ возлежи́ши, дла́нїю содержа́й всеѧ̀ землѝ концы̀, таковы́мъ бо смотре́нїемъ ꙋ҆вѣ́дѣно бы́сть милосе́рдїе твоѐ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ве́лїѧ ми́лость твоѧ̀, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Before Thy birth, O Lord, beholding Thy mystery with trembling, the spiritual hosts were astonished; for Thou Who didst adorn the heavens with stars wast well pleased to be born as an infant, and Thou Who holdest the ends of all the earth in Thy palm liest in a manger of brute beasts; for by such a dispensation Thy tender mercy hath been made known, O Christ: great is Thy mercy, glory to Thee.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Third Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Micah, Chapter 5:*[^10]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆ѡ́сифе, рцы̀ на́мъ, ка́кѡ ю҆́же ѿ ст҃ы́хъ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ дѣ́вꙋ, непра́зднꙋ приво́диши въ Виѳлее́мъ? А҆́зъ, речѐ, прⷪ҇ро́ки и҆спыта́хъ, и҆ вѣ́сть прїе́мъ ѿ а҆́гг҃ла, ꙋ҆вѣ́рихсѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃а роди́тъ Марї́а несказа́ннѡ: є҆мꙋ́же на поклоне́нїе волсвѝ ѿ восто́кѡвъ прїи́дꙋтъ, съ да́ры честны́ми слꙋжа́ще, воплоти́выйсѧ на́съ ра́ди, Гдⷭ҇и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Tell us, Joseph, how is it that the Virgin whom thou didst receive from the Holy of Holies thou bringest with child to Bethlehem? I, says he, have searched the prophets, and having received word from an angel, I am persuaded that Mary shall ineffably give birth to God; unto Whom the Magi from the East shall come to worship, serving Him with precious gifts: O Thou Who wast incarnate for our sake, Lord, glory to Thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, Гла́съ г҃. Дв҃а дне́сь превѣ́чное Сло́во, въ верте́пѣ грѧде́тъ роди́ти неизрече́ннѡ: ликꙋ́й вселе́н- наѧ ꙋ҆слы́шавши, просла́ви со А҆́гг҃лы и҆ па́- стырми, хотѧ́щаго ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ ѻ҆троча̀ мла́до превѣ́чнаго Бг҃а.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Влⷣко Бж҃е Ѻ҆́ч҃е вседержи́телю, Гдⷭ҇и Сн҃е є҆диноро́дный І҆и҃се Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ ст҃ы́й Дш҃е: є҆ди́но божество̀, є҆ди́на си́ла, поми́лꙋй мѧ̀ грѣ́шнаго, и҆ и҆́миже вѣ́си сꙋдьба́ми, спасѝ мѧ̀ недосто́й- наго раба̀ твоего̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ во вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́въ, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Master, God, Father Almighty, O Lord, the Only-Begotten Son, Jesus Christ, and Holy Spirit: one Godhead, one Power, have mercy on me, a sinner; and by the judgments which Thou knowest, save me, Thine unworthy servant: for Thou art blessed unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Sixth Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Jeremiah, Chapter 3:*[^19]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ не и҆́мамы дерзнове́нїѧ, за премнѡ́- гїѧ грѣхѝ на́шѧ, ты̀ и҆́же ѿ тебѐ ро́ждшаго- сѧ, молѝ Бцⷣе Дв҃о, мно́гѡ бо мо́жетъ мо- ле́нїе ма́тернее ко бл҃госе́рдїю Влⷣки, не пре́зри грѣ́шныхъ мольбы̀, всечи́стаѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивъ є҆́сть, и҆ спастѝ могїй, и҆́же и҆ страда́ти ѡ҆ на́съ и҆зво́ливый.
items.english_cohort_translation: Since we have no boldness on account of our manifold sins, do thou entreat Him Who was born of thee O Virgin Mother of God: for the supplication of a Mother avails much unto the loving-kindness of the Master. Despise not the petitions of sinners, O all-pure one, for He is merciful, and able to save, Who also was pleased to suffer for our sake.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Sixth Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Jeremiah, Chapter 3:*[^19]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те, вѣ́рнїи, возведе́мсѧ бо́жествен- нѣ, и҆ ви́димъ схожде́нїе боже́ственное свы́ше, въ Виѳлее́мѣ къ на́мъ ꙗ҆вле́ннѣ: и҆ ꙋ҆мо́мъ ѡ҆чи́стившесѧ, житїѐ принесе́мъ добродѣ́тели, вмѣ́стѡ мѵ́ра предꙋготовлѧ́юще вѣ́рнѡ рож- де́ственныѧ вхо́ды, ѿ дꙋше́вныхъ сокро́вищъ зовꙋ́ще: въ вы́шнихъ сла́ва Бг҃ꋋ сꙋ́щемꙋ въ
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, ye faithful, let us be lifted up divinely, and let us behold the divine condescension from on high made manifest unto us in Bethlehem; and being cleansed in mind, let us bring virtues instead of myrrh, faithfully preparing the entries of the Nativity, crying out from the treasures of our souls: Glory in the highest to God existing in Trinity, through Whom good will has appeared among men, delivering Adam from the primal curse, as the Lover of mankind.

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* God shall come from Theman, and the Holy One from the mountain overshadowed and densely wooded.[^27]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слы́ши нб҃о, и҆ внушѝ землѐ, да подви́- жатсѧ ѡ҆снова́нїа, да прїи́мꙋтъ тре́петъ пре- испо́днѧѧ: ꙗ҆́кѡ Бо́гъ же и҆ Творе́цъ въ пло́т- ское ѡ҆дѣ́ѧсѧ зда́нїе: и҆ и҆́же держа́вною рꙋко́ю созда́вый тва́рь, ꙋ҆тро́бы зри́тсѧ зда́нїе:
items.english_cohort_translation: Hear, O heaven, and give ear, O earth; let the foundations be shaken, let trembling lay hold on the depths of the nether regions: for God and Creator has clothed Himself in the bodily frame; and He Who created creation with a mighty hand is seen in the womb as a created being. items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те Хрⷭ҇тоно́снїи лю́дїе, да ви́димъ чꙋ́до всѧ́кїй ра́зꙋмъ ꙋ҆жаса́ющее и҆ ѡ҆бдержа́- щее: и҆ бл҃гоче́стнѡ воспѣва́юще вѣ́рнїи, по- клони́мсѧ: дне́сь къ Виѳлее́мꙋ непра́здна сꙋ́щи Дв҃а прихо́дитъ роди́ти Гдⷭ҇а: ли́цы же а҆́гг҃лстїи предтекꙋ́тъ, и҆ сїѧ̑ ви́дѣвъ вопїѧ́ше І҆ѡ́сифъ ѡ҆брꙋ́чникъ: что̀ є҆́же въ тебѣ̀ стра́н- ное та́инство Дв҃о? и҆ ка́кѡ хо́щеши роди́ти, неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ ю҆ни́це?
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, O Christ-bearing people, let us behold a wonder that astonishes every understanding and holds it fast and praising piously, ye faithful, let us worship: today the Virgin, being great with child, comes to Bethlehem to give birth to the Lord; and the choirs of angels run before Her; and beholding these things, Joseph the Betrothed cried out: What is this strange mystery in thee, O Virgin? And how art thou about to give birth, O Heifer that hast not known a mate?

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah, Chapter 7:*[^29]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃е и҆ Гдⷭ҇и си́лъ, и҆ всеѧ̀ тва́ри содѣ́телю, и҆́же за милосе́рдїе безприкла́дныѧ ми́лости твоеѧ̀, є҆диноро́днаго Сн҃а твоего̀, Гдⷭ҇а на́шего І҆и҃са Хрⷭ҇та̀, низпосла́вый на спасенї́е ро́да на́шегѡ: и҆ честны́мъ є҆гѡ̀ крⷭ҇то́мъ, рꙋкописа́нїе грѣ̑хъ на́шихъ растерза́вый, и҆ побѣди́вый тѣ́мъ нача̑ла и҆ вла̑сти тмы̀: са́мъ, Влⷣко чл҃вѣколю́бче, прїимѝ и҆ на́съ грѣ́шныхъ, бл҃годарє́ственныѧ сїѧ̑, и҆ моле́бныѧ моли̑твы, и҆ и҆зба́ви на́съ ѿ всѧ́кагѡ всегꙋби́телнагѡ, и҆ мра́чнагѡ прегрѣше́нїѧ, и҆ всѣ́хъ ѡ҆ѕло́бити на́съ и҆́щꙋщихъ, ви́димыхъ и҆ неви́димыхъ вра̑гъ, пригвоздѝ стра́хꙋ твоемꙋ̀ плѡ́ти на́шѧ, и҆ не ꙋ҆клонѝ серде́цъ на́шихъ въ словеса̀, и҆лѝ помышле́нїа лꙋка́вствїа, но любо́вїю твое́ю ꙋ҆ѧзвѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ, да къ тебѣ̀ всегда̀ взира́юще, и҆ є҆́же ѿ тебѐ свѣ́томъ наставлѧ́еми, тебѐ непристꙋ́пнаго и҆ присносꙋ́щнаго зрѧ́ще свѣ́та, непреста́нное тебѣ̀ и҆сповѣ́данїе, и҆ бл҃годарє́нїе возсыла́емъ, безнача́льномꙋ Ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀, со є҆диноро́днымъ твои́мъ Сн҃омъ, и҆ всест҃ы́мъ и҆ бл҃ги́мъ, и҆ животворѧ́щимъ твои́мъ Дх҃омъ, ны́нѣ и҆ при́снѡ, и҆ во вѣ́кы вѣкѡ́въ, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_cohort_translation: O God and Lord of hosts, and Maker of all creation, Who through the compassion of Thine incomparable mercy didst send down Thine Only-Begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, for the salvation of our race, and by His precious Cross didst tear up the handwriting of our sins, and thereby didst triumph over the principalities and powers of darkness: do Thou Thyself, O Master, Lover of mankind, accept also these thanksgiving and suppliant prayers of us sinners, and deliver us from every all-destroying and dark transgression, and from all enemies, visible and invisible, that seek to do us harm; nail our flesh to Thy fear, and incline not our hearts to words or thoughts of evil, but wound our souls with Thy love, that always gazing upon Thee, and guided by the light that comes from Thee, beholding Thee, the unapproachable and everlasting Light, we may send up unceasing confession and thanksgiving unto Thee, the Father without beginning, with Thine Only-Begotten Son, and Thine All-Holy, Good, and Life-Creating Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.english_text: O God and Lord of hosts, and Maker of all creation, Who through the compassion of Thine incomparable mercy didst send down Thine Only-Begotten Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, for the salvation of our race, and by His precious Cross didst tear up the handwriting of our sins, and thereby didst triumph over the principalities and powers of darkness: do Thou Thyself, O Master, Lover of mankind, accept also these thanksgiving and suppliant prayers of us sinners, and deliver us from every all-destroying and dark transgression, and from all enemies, visible and invisible, that seek to do us harm; nail our flesh to Thy fear, and incline not our hearts to words or thoughts of evil, but wound our souls with Thy love, that always gazing upon Thee, and guided by the light that comes from Thee, beholding Thee, the unapproachable and everlasting Light, we may send up unceasing confession and thanksgiving unto Thee, the Father without beginning, with Thine Only-Begotten Son, and Thine All-Holy, Good, and Life-Creating Spirit, both now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да́ти и҆̀мъ достоѧ́нїе ꙗ҆зы́къ:* дѣла̀ рꙋ́къ є҆гѡ̀ и҆́стина и҆ сꙋ́дъ.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Ninth Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah, Chapter 7:*[^29]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Написова́шесѧ и҆ногда̀ со ста́рцемъ І҆ѡ́сифомъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ сѣ́мене Дв҃дова, въ Виѳлеє́мѣ Мрїа́мъ, чревоносѧ́щи безсѣ́менное рожде́нїе: наста́ же вре́мѧ рождества̀, и҆ мѣ́сто ниєди́ноже бѣ̀ ѡ҆быта́лищꙋ: но ꙗ҆́коже кра́снаѧ пала́та, верте́пъ цр҃и́цѣ показа́шесѧ, Хрⷭ҇то́съ ражда́етсѧ, пре́жде па́дшїй воскреси́ти ѻ҆́бразъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Mary was once registered with the elder Joseph in Bethlehem as being of the seed of David, bearing in her womb the seedless conception; and the time of the birth arrived, and there was no place in the inn; but as a fair palace, the cave was shown forth to the Queen. Christ is born, to raise up the image that fell of old.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Ninth Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah, Chapter 7:*[^29]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же на́съ ра́ди рожде́йсѧ ѿ Дѣ́вы, и҆ распѧ́тїе претерпѣ́въ бл҃гі́й, и҆спрове́ргїй сме́ртїю сме́рть, и҆ воскресе́нїе ꙗ҆вле́й ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ, непре́зри ꙗ҆́же созда́лъ є҆сѝ рꙋко́ю твое́ю: ꙗ҆вѝ человѣколю́бїе твоѐ, ми́лостиве, прїимѝ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ Бцⷣꙋ молѧ́щꙋюсѧ за ны̀, и҆ спасѝ, Спа́се на́шъ, лю́ди ѿча́ѧнныѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who for our sake wast born of the Virgin, and didst endure crucifixion, O Good One, Who by death didst overthrow death, and manifested the Resurrection as God: despise not those whom Thou hast fashioned with Thine hand; show forth Thy love for mankind, O Merciful One; accept the Mother of God who bore Thee, who intercedes for us; and save, O our Savior, a despairing people.

items.verbatim_book_heading: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ :: Ninth Hour
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Reading from the Prophecy of Isaiah, Chapter 7:*[^29]
items.season_or_tone: Order of the Royal Hours on the Eve of the Nativity of Christ
items.day_or_date: General
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆дивла́шесѧ И҆́рѡдъ, зрѧ̀ волхвѡ́въ бл҃гоче́стїе: и҆ гнѣ́вомъ побѣжда́емъ, лѣ̑та и҆спыта́ше разстоѧ́нїа, ма́тере безча́дствꙋеми быва́хꙋ, и҆ безвре́менный во́зрастъ младе́нцевъ го́рцѣ пожина́шесѧ, сосцы̀ ссыха́хꙋсѧ, и҆ и҆сто́чницы млѣ́чнїи ꙋ҆держава́хꙋсѧ, ве́лїе бѧ́ше лю́тое, тѣ́мже бл҃гоче́стнѡ вѣ́рнїи соше́дшесѧ, поклони́мсѧ Хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ рождествꙋ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Herod was astonished, beholding the piety of the Magi; and overcome with wrath, he searched out the span of years: mothers were made childless, and the untimely age of infants was bitterly reaped, breasts dried up, and streams of milk were held back; great was the woe! Therefore, ye faithful, having gathered together piously, let us worship the Nativity of Christ.

items.english_text: Herod was astonished, beholding the piety of the Magi; and overcome with wrath, he searched out the span of years: mothers were made childless, and the untimely age of infants was bitterly reaped, breasts dried up, and streams of milk were held back; great was the woe! Therefore, ye faithful, having gathered together piously, let us worship the Nativity of Christ.

slavonic_provenance.verbatim_source: Оу҆дивла́шесѧ И҆́рѡдъ, зрѧ̀ волхвѡ́въ бл҃гоче́стїе: и҆ гнѣ́вомъ побѣжда́емъ, лѣ̑та и҆спыта́ше разстоѧ́нїа, ма́тере безча́дствꙋеми быва́хꙋ, и҆ безвре́менный во́зрастъ младе́нцевъ го́рцѣ пожина́шесѧ, сосцы̀ ссыха́хꙋсѧ, и҆ и҆сто́чницы млѣ́чнїи ꙋ҆держава́хꙋсѧ, ве́лїе бѧ́ше лю́тое, тѣ́мже бл҃гоче́стнѡ вѣ́рнїи соше́дшесѧ, поклони́мсѧ Хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ рождествꙋ̀.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь, Гла́съ в҃. Є҆гда̀ І҆ѡ́сифъ Дѣ́во печа́лїю ꙋ҆ѧзвлѧ́шесѧ, къ Виѳлеє́мꙋ и҆дѧ̀, вопїѧ́ла є҆сѝ къ немꙋ̀: что̀ мѧ̀ зрѧ̀ непра́зднꙋ дрѧ́хлꙋеши и҆ смꙋща́ешисѧ, не вѣ́дый всѧ́кѡ є҆́же во мнѣ̀ стра́шнагѡ та́инства? про́чее ѿложѝ стра́хъ всѧ́къ, пресла́вное познава́ѧ, Бо́гъ бо низхо́дитъ на зе́млю ми́лости ра́ди, во чре́вѣ мое́мъ ны́нѣ, а҆́ще и҆ пло́ть прїѧ́тъ, є҆го́же ражда́ема ꙋ҆́зриши, ꙗ҆́коже бл҃гоизво́ли, и҆ ра́дости и҆спо́лнивсѧ поклони́шисѧ ꙗ҆́кѡ зижди́телю твоемꙋ̀, є҆го́же а҆́гг҃ли пою́тъ непреста́ннѡ, и҆ славосло́вѧтъ со Ѻ҆ц҃е́мъ и҆ Дх҃омъ ст҃ы́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 2:* When Joseph was wounded with sorrow, O Virgin, going to Bethlehem, thou didst cry out unto him: Why art thou downcast and troubled, seeing me with child, knowing not at all the awesome mystery that is in me? Henceforth cast aside all fear, recognizing what is most glorious: for God descends to earth for mercy's sake, in my womb now, having taken flesh; Whom being born thou shalt behold, even as He was well pleased, and filled with joy thou shalt worship Him as thy Maker, Whom the angels unceasingly praise and glorify with the Father and the Holy Spirit.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь ражда́етсѧ ѿ Дѣ́вы, рꙋко́ю всю̀ содержа́й тва́рь: пелена́ми ꙗ҆́коже зе́менъ повива́етсѧ, и҆́же сꙋщество́мъ неприкоснове́ненъ Бо́гъ: въ ꙗ҆́слѣхъ возлежи́тъ, ꙋ҆тверди́вый небеса̀ сло́вомъ въ нача́лцѣхъ, ѿ сосце́въ млеко́мъ пита́етсѧ, и҆́же въ пꙋсты́ни ма́ннꙋ ѡ҆дожди́вый лю́демъ, волхвы̀ призыва́етъ, жени́хъ церко́вный, да́ры си́хъ прїе́млетъ Сн҃ъ Дѣ́вы, покланѧ́емсѧ рождествꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, покланѧ́емсѧ рождествꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, покланѧ́емсѧ рождествꙋ̀ твоемꙋ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, покажѝ на́мъ и҆ боже́ственнаѧ твоѧ̑ бг҃оѧвле́нїа.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today is born of the Virgin He Who holds all creation in His hand; He is wrapped in swaddling clothes like a mortal, Who in His essence is intangible God; He lies in a manger Who established the heavens by His word in the beginning; He is nourished with milk from the breasts, Who rained down manna upon the people in the wilderness; the Bridegroom of the Church calls the Magi, the Son of the Virgin receives their gifts: We worship Thy Nativity, O Christ; we worship Thy Nativity, O Christ; we worship Thy Nativity, O Christ: show us also Thy divine Theophanies.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, Гла́съ г҃. Дѣ́ва дне́сь превѣ́чное Сло́во, въ верте́пѣ грѧде́тъ роди́ти неизрече́ннѡ: ликꙋ́й вселе́ннаѧ ꙋ҆слы́шавши, просла́ви со а҆́гг҃лы и҆ па́стырьми хотѧ́щаго ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ, ѻ҆троча̀ мла́до превѣ́чнаго Бг҃а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3:* Today the Virgin comes to the cave to give birth ineffably to the Pre-eternal Word: dance, O inhabited earth, when thou hearest; glorify with the angels and the shepherds Him Who wills to appear as a young Child, the Pre-eternal God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Влⷣко Гдⷭ҇и, І҆и҃се Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е на́шъ, долготерпѣ́вый ѡ҆ на́шихъ согрѣше́нїихъ, и҆ да́же до ны́нѣшнѧгѡ часа̀ приведы́й на́съ, во́нже на животворѧ́щемъ дре́вѣ ви́сѧ, бл҃горазꙋ́мномꙋ разбо́йникꙋ, и҆́же въ ра́й пꙋтесотвори́лъ є҆сѝ вхо́дъ, и҆ сме́ртїю сме́рть разрꙋши́лъ є҆сѝ: ѡ҆чи́сти на́съ грѣ́шныхъ, и҆ недосто́йныхъ ра̑бъ твои́хъ, согрѣши́хомъ бо и҆ беззако́нновахомъ, и҆ нѣ́смы досто́йни возвестѝ ѻ҆чеса̀ на̑ша, и҆ воззрѣ́ти на высотꙋ̀ нб҃нꙋю: занѐ ѡ҆ста́ви- хомъ пꙋть пра́вды твоеѧ̀, и҆ ходи́хомъ въ во́лѧхъ серде́цъ на́шихъ, но мо́лимъ твою̀ безмѣ́рнꙋю бл҃гость: пощадѝ на́съ, Гдⷭ҇и, по мно́жествꙋ ми́лости твоеѧ̀, и҆ спасѝ на́съ и҆́мене твоегѡ̀ ра́ди ст҃а́гѡ, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆счезо́ша въ сꙋетѣ̀ дні́е на́ши. И҆змѝ на́съ и҆зъ рꙋкѝ сопроти́внагѡ, и҆ ѡ҆ста́ви на́мъ грѣхѝ на́ша, и҆ ꙋ҆мертвѝ плотско́е на́ше мꙋдрова́ніе. Да ве́тхаго ѿложи́вше человѣ́ка, въ но́ваго ѡ҆блече́мсѧ: и҆ тебѣ̀ поживе́мъ на́шемꙋ Влⷣцѣ и҆ Бл҃годѣ́телю, и҆ та́кѡ твои́мъ послѣ́дꙋюще повелѣ́ніемъ, въ вѣ́чный поко́й дости́гнемъ: и҆́дѣже є҆́сть всѣ́хъ весе́лѧщихсѧ жили́ще, ты́ бо є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ и҆́стинное весе́ліе, и҆ ра́дость лю́бѧщихъ тѧ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, Бж҃е на́шъ, и҆ тебѣ̀ сла́вꙋ возсыла́емъ, со безнача́льнымъ твои́мъ О҆ц҃е́мъ, и҆ прест҃ы́мъ и҆ бл҃ги́мъ, и҆ животворѧ́щимъ твои́мъ Дх҃омъ, ны́нѣ и҆ при́снѡ, и҆ во вѣ́ки вѣкѡ́въ, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Master, Lord Jesus Christ our God, Who art long-suffering over our transgressions, and hast brought us even unto this present hour, in which, hanging upon the life-creating Wood, Thou didst open the entrance into Paradise to the wise thief, and by death didst destroy death: cleanse us sinners and Thine unworthy servants; for we have sinned and committed iniquity, and we are not worthy to lift up our eyes and look upon the height of heaven, because we have forsaken the path of Thy righteousness, and have walked in the desires of our hearts. But we implore Thine immeasurable goodness: spare us, O Lord, according to the multitude of Thy mercy, and save us for Thy holy name's sake, for our days have vanished in vanity. Pluck us from the hand of the adversary, forgive us our sins, and put to death our carnal desires, that, having put off the old man, we may put on the new, and live unto Thee, our Master and Benefactor; and thus, following Thy commandments, we may attain unto eternal rest, where is the dwelling of all that rejoice. For Thou truly art the true joy and exultation of those who love Thee, O Christ our God, and unto Thee do we send up glory, together with Thine unoriginate Father, and Thy most holy and good and life-creating Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, Гла́съ г҃. Дѣ́ва дне́сь превѣ́чное сло́во, въ верте́пѣ грѧде́тъ роди́ти неизрече́ннѡ, ликꙋ́й вселе́ннаѧ ꙋ҆слы́шавши, просла́ви со а҆́гг҃лы и҆ па́стырьми, хотѧ́щаго ꙗ҆ви́тисѧ, ѻ҆троча̀ мла́до превѣ́чнаго Бг҃а.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3:* Today the Virgin comes to the cave to give birth ineffably to the Pre-eternal Word: dance, O inhabited earth, when thou hearest; glorify with the angels and the shepherds Him Who wills to appear as a young Child, the Pre-eternal God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всест҃а́ѧ Тро́йце, є҆диносꙋ́щнаѧ держа́во, нераздѣ́льное ца́рство, всѣ́хъ благи́хъ вина̀: бл҃говолѝ же и҆ ѡ҆ мнѣ̀ грѣ́шнѣмъ, ꙋ҆твердѝ, вразмꙋ́й се́рдце моѐ, и҆ всю̀ мою̀ ѿимѝ скве́рнꙋ, просвѣтѝ мою̀ мы́сль, да вы́нꙋ сла́влю, пою̀, и҆ покланѧ́юсѧ, и҆ глаго́лю: Є҆ди́нъ ст҃ъ, є҆ди́нъ Гдⷭ҇ь, І҆исꙋ́съ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, во сла́вꙋ Бо́га Ѻ҆ц҃а̀, а҆ми́нь.
items.english_cohort_translation: All-holy Trinity, consubstantial dominion, undivided kingdom, Cause of all good things: be favorably inclined even toward me, a sinner; strengthen and give understanding to my heart, and take away all my defilement; enlighten my mind, that I may continually praise, sing, and worship, and say: One is holy, One is Lord, Jesus Christ, to the glory of God the Father. Amen.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пресвѧтꙋ́ю, пречи́стꙋю преблагослове́ннꙋю, сла́внꙋю Влⷣчцꙋ на́шꙋ Бцⷣꙋ, и҆ приснодѣ́вꙋ Марї́ю, со всѣ́ми Ст҃ы́ми помѧнꙋ́вше, са́ми себѐ, и҆ дрꙋ́гъ дрꙋ́га, и҆ ве́сь живо́тъ на́шъ, Хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ Бо́гꙋ предади́мъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь, Гла́съ д҃. Рождество̀ твоѐ, Хрⷭтѐ Бж҃е на́шъ, возсїѧ̀ мі́рови свѣ́тъ ра́зума: въ не́мъ бо ѕвѣзда́мъ служа́щїи, ѕвѣздо́ю оу҆ча́хусѧ, тебѣ̀ кла́нятисѧ со́лнцу пра́вды, и҆ тебѐ вѣ́дѣти въ высоты̀ восто́ка: Гдⷭи, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:*[^118] Thy Nativity, O Christ our God, has shone to the world the light of wisdom; for by it, they that worshipped the stars were taught by a star to worship Thee, the Sun of righteousness, and to know Thee from on high, the Dayspring: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́лїе и҆ пресла́вное чꙋ́до соверши́сѧ дне́сь: Дѣ́ва ражда́етъ, и҆ ꙋ҆тро́ба не и҆стлѣва́етъ: Сло́во воплоща́етсѧ, и҆ Ѻ҆тца̀ не ѿлꙋча́етсѧ, А҆́гг҃ли съ па́стырми сла́вѧтъ: и҆ мы̀ съ ни́ми вопїе́мъ: сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃ꙋ, и҆ на землѝ ми́ръ.
items.english_cohort_translation: A great and most glorious wonder is accomplished today! A Virgin gives birth, and her womb suffers no corruption; the Word is incarnate, and is not separated from the Father! Angels with shepherds give glory, and we with them cry out: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace!

items.preceding_stichos: Verse:* Out of the womb before the morning star have I begotten Thee: the Lord has sworn, and will not repent.[^138]
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь ражда́етъ Дѣ́ва творца̀ всѣ́хъ, є҆де́мъ прино́ситъ верте́пъ, и҆ ѕвѣзда̀ пока́зꙋетъ Хрⷭ҇та̀ со́лнца сꙋ́щымъ во тмѣ̀: съ да́ры волсвѝ поклони́шасѧ, вѣ́рою просвѣща́еми, и҆ па́стырїе ви́дѣша чꙋ́до, а҆́гг҃лѡмъ воспѣва́ющымъ и҆ глаго́лющымъ: сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бо́гꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the Virgin gives birth to the Creator of all; Eden offers a cave, and a star reveals Christ the Sun to those who are in darkness. With gifts the Magi bowed down in worship, enlightened by faith; and the shepherds saw the wonder, while Angels sang and said: Glory to God in the highest!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гдⷭꙋ І҆и҃сꙋ ро́ждшꙋсѧ въ Виѳлеє́мѣ І҆ꙋде́йстѣмъ, ѿ востѡ́къ прише́дше волсвѝ, поклони́шасѧ Бг҃ꙋ вочеловѣ́чшꙋсѧ, и҆ сокрѡ́вища своѧ̀ ꙋ҆се́рднѡ ѿве́рзше, да́ры честны́ѧ приноша́хꙋ: и҆скꙋше́но зла́то, ꙗ҆́кѡ цр҃ю̀ вѣкѡ́въ: и҆ лїва́нъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ꙋ всѣ́хъ: ꙗ҆́кѡ тридне́вномꙋ же мертвецꙋ̀, смѵ́рнꙋ безсме́ртномꙋ, всѝ ꙗ҆зы́цы прїиди́те поклони́мсѧ ро́ждшемꙋсѧ, спастѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: When the Lord Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea, Magi having arrived from the East worshipped God made man, and eagerly opening their treasures, they offered honorable gifts: refined gold, as to the King of the ages; and frankincense, as to the God of all; and as to one three days dead, myrrh to the Immortal One! All you nations, come, let us bow down in worship unto Him Who is born to save our souls.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Весели́сѧ, І҆ерꙋсали́ме, торжествꙋ́йте всѝ любѧ́щїи Сїѡ́на, дне́сь вре́менный разрѣши́сѧ сою́зъ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ А҆да́мова, ра́й на́мъ ѿве́рзесѧ, ѕмі́й ꙋ҆праздни́сѧ: ю҆́же бо прельстѝ пе́рвѣе, ны́нѣ ꙋ҆зрѣ̀ содѣ́телевꙋ бы́вшꙋ ма́терь: Ѽ глꙋбина̀ бога́тства, и҆ премꙋ́дрости и҆ ра́зꙋма Бж҃їѧ! ꙗ҆́же и҆схода́таивши сме́рть все́й пло́ти, грѣхо́вный сосꙋ́дъ, спасенїѧ нача́ло бы́сть мі́рꙋ всемꙋ̀, Бцⷣы ра́ди, мл҃нцъ бо ражда́етсѧ и҆зъ неѧ̀, всесоверше́нный Бо́гъ: и҆ рождество́мъ дѣ́вство печа́тствꙋетъ: пленѝцы грѣхѡ́вныѧ разрѣша́ѧй пелена́ми, и҆ младе́нства ра́ди Е҆́ѵины врачꙋ́етъ, ꙗ҆́же въ печа́лѣхъ болѣ̑зни, да ликовствꙋ́етъ ꙋ҆́бѡ всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ да и҆гра́етъ: ѡ҆бнови́ти бо ю҆̀ прїи́де Хрⷭ҇то́съ, и҆ спастѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice, O Jerusalem! Make festival, all you who love Zion! Today the temporal bond of Adam's condemnation is loosed; paradise is opened unto us, and the serpent is abolished! For her whom he deceived of old, he now sees become the Mother of the Creator. O the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! The vessel of sin that brought death upon all flesh has become the beginning of salvation for the whole world, for the sake of the Theotokos; for a babe is born of her, the all-perfect God, and by His birth He seals her virginity; loosing the bonds of sins by swaddling bands, and through His infancy healing the sorrows of Eve that were in travail. Let all creation therefore keep festival and leap for joy; for Christ is come to renew it, and to save our souls.
items.slavonic_text: Весели́сѧ, І҆ерꙋсали́ме, торжествꙋ́йте всѝ любѧ́щїи Сїѡ́на, дне́сь вре́менный разрѣши́сѧ сою́зъ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїѧ А҆да́мова, ра́й на́мъ ѿве́рзесѧ, ѕмі́й ꙋ҆праздни́сѧ: ю҆́же бо прельстѝ пе́рвѣе, ны́нѣ ꙋ҆зрѣ̀ содѣ́телевꙋ бы́вшꙋ ма́терь: Ѽ глꙋбина̀ бога́тства, и҆ премꙋ́дрости и҆ ра́зꙋма Бж҃їѧ! ꙗ҆́же и҆схода́таивши сме́рть все́й пло́ти, грѣхо́вный сосꙋ́дъ, спасенїѧ нача́ло бы́сть мі́рꙋ всемꙋ̀, Бцⷣы ра́ди, мл҃нцъ бо ражда́етсѧ и҆зъ неѧ̀, всесоверше́нный Бо́гъ: и҆ рождество́мъ дѣ́вство печа́тствꙋетъ: пленѝцы грѣхѡ́вныѧ разрѣша́ѧй пелена́ми, и҆ младе́нства ра́ди Е҆́ѵины врачꙋ́етъ, ꙗ҆́же въ печа́лѣхъ болѣ̑зни, да ликовствꙋ́етъ ꙋ҆́бѡ всѧ̀ тва́рь, и҆ да и҆гра́етъ: ѡ҆бнови́ти бо ю҆̀ прїи́де Хрⷭ҇то́съ, и҆ спастѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.

For her whom he deceived of old, he now sees become the Mother of the Creator. O the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! The vessel of sin that brought death upon all flesh has become the beginning of salvation for the whole world, for the sake of the Theotokos; for a babe is born of her, the all-perfect God, and by His birth He seals her virginity; loosing the bonds of sins by swaddling bands, and through His infancy healing the sorrows of Eve that were in travail. Let all creation therefore keep festival and leap for joy; for Christ is come to renew it, and to save our souls.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ верте́пъ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ, Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, ꙗ҆́сли тѧ̀ воспрїѧ́ша, па́стырїе же и҆ волсвѝ поклони́шасѧ, тогда̀ ꙋ҆́бѡ проро́ческаѧ и҆спо́лнисѧ про́повѣдь: и҆ а҆́гг҃лскїѧ си́лы дивлѧ́хꙋсѧ, вопїю́ще, и҆ глаго́люще: сла́ва схожде́нїю твоемꙋ̀, є҆ди́не человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst take up Thy dwelling in a cave, O Christ God; a manger received Thee, and shepherds and Magi worshipped. Then indeed was the prophetic preaching fulfilled; and the Angelic Hosts marveled, crying out and saying: Glory to Thy condescension, O only Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рождество̀ твоѐ Хрⷭтѐ Бж҃е на́шъ, возсія̀ мі́рови свѣ́тъ ра́зума: въ не́мъ бо звѣзда́мъ служа́щіи, звѣздо́ю оу҆ча́хуся, тебѣ̀ кла́нятися со́лнцу пра́вды, и҆ тебѐ вѣ́дѣти въ высотѣ̀ восто́ка: Гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ̀, в҃.

items.english_cohort_translation: The pre-eternal and incomprehensible One, co-everlasting with the invisible Father, hast thou bodily borne in thy womb, O Mother of God, the one and unconfused Godhead of the Trinity; thy grace has shone forth, hymned in the world; therefore we cry out unceasingly: Rejoice, pure Virgin Mother!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те ви́димъ вѣ́рніи, гдѣ̀ роди́ся Хрⷭто́съ, послѣ́дуемъ про́чее я̂мо́же и҆́детъ звѣзда̀, съ волхвы̀ восто́чными ца́ри: є҆гѡ́же а҆́ггли пою́тъ непреста́ннѡ та́мѡ, па́стыріе свиря́ютъ пѣ́снь досто́йную: Сла́ва къ вы́шнихъ, глаго́люще, дне́сь въ верте́пѣ Ро́ждшемуся ѿ Дѣ́вы и҆ Бдⷭцы въ Виѳлее́мѣ І҆уде́йсткомъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆и҃съ Хрⷭто́во рождество̀, си́це бѣ̀: ѡ҆бруче́нѣй оу҆́бѡ бы́вши ма́тери є҆гѡ̀ Мр҃і́и І҆ѡ́сифови, пре́жде да́же не сни́тися и҆́ма, ѡ҆брѣ́теся и҆му́щи во чре́вѣ ѿ Дх҃а ст҃а. І҆ѡ́сифъ же му́жъ є҆я̀ пра́веденъ сы́й, и҆ не хотя̀ є҆я̀ ѡ҆бличи́ти, восхотѣ̀ та́й пусти́ти ю̂. Сія̂ же є҆му̀ помы́слившу, и҆ а҆́гг҃лъ Гдⷭнь во снѣ̀ я҆ви́ся є҆му̀, глаго́ля: І҆ѡ́сифе сы́не Дв҃довъ, не оу҆бо́йся прія́ти Маріа́мъ жены̀ твоея̀, ро́ждшеебося въ не́й, ѿ Дх҃а е҆́сть ст҃а. Роди́тъ же сн҃а, и҆ нарече́ши и҆́мя є҆му̀ І҆и҃съ, то́й бо спасе́тъ лю́ди своя̂ ѿ грѣ́хъ и҆́хъ. Сіѐ же всѐ бы́сть, да сбу́дется рече́нное ѿ Гдⷭа прⷪро́комъ глаго́лющимъ: Сѐ Дѣ́ва во чре́вѣ прі́йметъ, и҆ роди́тъ сы́на, и҆ нареку́тъ и҆́мя є҆му̀ Е҆мману́илъ: є҆́же е҆́сть сказа́емо: съ на́ми Бо́гъ. Воста́въ же І҆ѡ́сифъ ѿ сна̀, сотворѝ я҆́коже повелѣ̀ є҆му̀ а҆́гг҃лъ Гдⷭнь: и҆ прія́тъ жену̀ свою̀. И҆ не зна́еши є҆я̀, до́ндеже родѝ сы́на своего̀ пе́рвенца, и҆ наречѐ и҆́мя є҆му̀ І҆и҃съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The birth of Jesus Christ was on this wise: When as His mother Mary was espoused to Joseph, before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Spirit. Then Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing to make her a public example, was minded to put her away privily. But while he thought on these things, behold, the angel of the Lord appeared unto him in a dream, saying: Joseph, thou son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife; for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit. And she shall bring forth a Son, and thou shalt call His name Jesus, for He shall save His people from their sins. Now all this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken of the Lord by the prophet, saying: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a Son, and they shall call His name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, God with us. Then Joseph, being raised from sleep, did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife; and knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn Son; and he called His name Jesus.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃у, и҆ на землѝ ми́ръ; дне́сь воспріе́млетъ Виѳлее́мъ сѣдя́щаго при́снѡ со Ѻ҆тце́мъ; дне́сь а҆́гг҃ли младе́нца рожде́ннаго бг҃олѣ́пнѡ славосло́вятъ: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃у, и҆ на землѝ ми́ръ, въ человѣ́цѣхъ бл҃говоле́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace; today Bethlehem receives Him Who sits ever with the Father; today the angels praise in godlike manner the newborn Infant: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will among men!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆стлѣ́вша преступле́ніемъ, по Бо́жію ѻ҆́бразу бы́вшаго, всегѡ̀ тлѣ́нія су́ща лу́чшія ѿпа́дша бж҃е́ственныя жи́зни, па́ки ѡ҆бновля́етъ му́дрый содѣ́тель, я҆́кѡ просла́вися.
items.english_cohort_translation: Him who was made in the image of God, but had fallen into corruption through transgression, and having entirely fallen away from the higher divine life was subject to decay, the wise Creator renews once again; for He has been glorified!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ви́дѣвъ зижди́тель ги́блема человѣ́ка, рука́ми є҆гѡ́же созда̀, приклони́въ небеса̀ схо́дитъ: сегѡ́ же ѿ Дѣ́вы бж҃е́ственныя чⷭтыя, всегѡ̀ ѡ҆существля́етъ: вои́стинну вопло́щся, я҆́кѡ просла́вися.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Му́дрость, сло́во, и҆ си́ла, Сы́нъ сы́й Ѻ҆́чій, и҆ сія́ніе, Хрⷭто́съ Бг҃ъ, си́лъ оу҆та́йвся, е҆ли́кѡ премі́рныхъ, и҆ е҆ли́кѡ на землѝ, и҆ вочеловѣ́чся ѡ҆бнови́лъ е҆́сть на́съ, я҆́кѡ просла́вися.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆знесѐ чре́во сїе́нное сло́во я҆́вѣ неопа́лнѡ живопи́санное купино́ю: смѣ́шена зра́комъ человѣ́чимъ Бг҃а, Е҆́ѵы ѡ҆кая́нную оу҆тро́бу кля́твы дре́внія разрѣша́ющее го́ркія, є҆гѡ́же земні́и сла́вимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Working marvels, the Master saved the people, of old turning the watery wave of the sea into dry land; and having of His own will been born of a Virgin, He sets for us a path leading to heaven; Whom, equal in essence to both the Father and to men, we glorify.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Показа̀ звѣзда̀ пре́жде со́лнца Сло́во прише́дшее оу҆ста́вити грѣхы̀, волхвѡ́мъ, я҆́вѣ во оу҆бо́зѣмъ верте́пѣ, ми́лостиваго тебѐ, пелена́ми пови́та, є҆гѡ́же ра́дующеся ви́дяху самого̀ и҆ человѣ́ка и҆ Гдⷭа.
items.english_cohort_translation: The sanctified womb clearly brought forth the Word, prefigured unburnt by the bush: God mingled with human form, releasing Eve’s wretched womb from the bitter ancient curse; Whom we earthborn glorify.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же духнове́нія прича́щся лу́чшагѡ А҆да́мъ пе́рстный, и҆ къ тлѣ́нію попо́лзся же́нскою ле́стію, Хрⷭта̀ ѿ жены̀ ви́дя, вопіе́тъ: и҆́же менѐ ра́ди по мнѣ̀ бы́въ, ст҃ъ есѝ Гдⷭи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Adam, formed of dust, having partaken of the higher inbreathing, yet slipped into decay through woman’s deceit, seeing Christ born of a woman, cries out: Thou Who for my sake hast become like unto me, holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сообра́зенъ бре́нному оумале́нію, растворе́ніемъ Хрⷭтѐ бы́въ: прича́стіемъ пло́ти го́ршія, пода́въ боже́ственнагѡ є҆стества̀: зе́мленъ бы́въ, и҆ пребы́въ Бо́гъ: и҆ возвы́сивый ро́гъ на́шъ, ст҃ъ есѝ Гдⷭи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having conformed Thyself to our lowly clay, O Christ, through the mingling, and by partaking of the baser flesh having imparted of the divine nature, earthly becoming, yet remaining God; and having exalted our horn, holy art Thou, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Виѳлее́ме весели́ся, князе́й І҆у́довыхъ сы́й цр҃ь, І҆и҃ля бо пасы́й, на ра́мѣхъ херуві́мскихъ, и҆зъ тебѐ про́йде Хрⷭто́съ я҆́вѣ: и҆ вознесы́й ро́гъ на́шъ, на́дъ всѣ́ми воцари́ся.
items.english_cohort_translation: Be glad, O Bethlehem, being king of the princes of Judah; for He that shepherds Israel, Who rides upon the shoulders of the Cherubim, has manifestly come forth from thee, Christ; and having exalted our horn, He has reigned over all.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Невѣ́сты пречи́стыя пребога́тое рождество̀, ви́дѣти па́че оу҆ма̀ сподо́бився, ли́къ свиря́ющихъ, преклоня́шеся стра́ннымъ ѻ҆́бразомъ: чи́нъ же пою́щихъ безпло́тныхъ, цр҃я̀ Хрⷭта̀ безсѣ́меннѡ вопло́щшагося.
items.english_cohort_translation: Accounted worthy beyond understanding to behold the most bountiful childbirth of the all-pure Bride, the choir of them that piped bowed down in marvelous manner; and the rank of the bodiless hosts sang of Christ the King, incarnate without seed.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Высото́ю црⷭтвуяй небе́съ, милосе́рдіемъ соверша́етъ ѡ҆ на́съ, и҆зъ безневѣ́стныя ѻ҆трокови́цы, невеще́ственъ сы́й пре́жде: но послѣ́жде сло́во ѡ҆дебелѣ́вшо пло́тію, да па́дшаго къ себѣ̀ привлече́тъ первозда́ннаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: Reigning in the height of the heavens, by His tender mercy He accomplishes salvation for us, from the unwedded Maiden, being immaterial before; but in these last days the Word took gross flesh, that He might draw unto Himself fallen Adam, the first-formed man.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Нача́токъ язы́кѡвъ, не́бо тебѣ̀ принесѐ, лежа́щему млⷣнцу во я҆́слѣхъ, звѣздо́ю волхвы̀ призва́вый, я҆̀же и҆ оу҆жаса́ше, не ски́птры и҆ престо́лы, но послѣ́дняя нищета̀: что́ бо ху́ждше верте́па? что́ же смире́ннѣе пеле́нъ? въ ни́хже просія̀ божества̀ твоегѡ̀ бога́тство: Гдⷭи сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Hypakoe, Tone 8:*[^171] The firstfruits of the nations did heaven bring unto Thee, lying an infant in the manger, having summoned the Magi by a star; whom neither scepters nor thrones amazed, but the uttermost poverty: for what is meaner than a cave? What is lowlier than swaddling clothes? Yet in them shone forth the riches of Thy divinity: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь д҃ — І҆рмо́съ: Же́злъ и҆зъ ко́рене І҆ессе́ева, и҆ цвѣ́тъ ѿ негѡ̀ Хрⷭ҇тѐ ѿ Дѣ́вы прозя́блъ є҆сѝ, и҆зъ горы̀ хва́льный, приосѣне́нныя ча́щи, прише́лъ є҆сѝ вопло́щьсѧ, ѿ неискусому́жныя невеще́ственный и҆ Бж҃е, сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Го́споди.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rod of the stem of Jesse, and blossom from it, O Christ, Thou hast budded forth from the Virgin; from the praised, overshadowed mountain, from the dense forest, Thou hast come, having become incarnate from the unwedded Maiden, Thou immaterial and God: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Е҆го́же дре́вле проречѐ І҆а́кѡвъ, ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ ѡ҆жида́нїе Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ѿ колѣ́на І҆ꙋ́дова возсїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ си́лꙋ дама́сковꙋ, самарї́йскꙋю же кори́сть прише́лъ є҆сѝ и҆спроверщѝ: ле́сть премѣнѧ́ѧ въ вѣ́рꙋ бг҃олѣ́пнꙋ, сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Го́споди.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Whom of old Jacob foretold, the Expectation of the nations, O Christ, hast shone forth from the tribe of Judah; and Thou hast come to overthrow the power of Damascus and the spoils of Samaria, changing deceit into faith worthy of God: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Волхва̀ дре́вле Валаа́ма словесы̀, ᲂу҆чи́кꙋ мꙋ́дрыѧ, ѕвѣздоблюсти́тели, ра́дости и҆спо́лнилъ є҆сѝ: ѕвѣзда̀ ѿ І҆а́кѡва возсїѧ́въ Влⷣко, ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ нача́токъ вводи́мый, прїѧ́лъ же є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́вѣ, сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Го́споди.
items.english_cohort_translation: By the words of the diviner Balaam of old, Thou hast filled with joy the wise stargazers, his disciples; having shone forth as a star out of Jacob, O Master, and taking the firstfruits of the nations led in, Thou didst manifestly receive them: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ на рꙋно̀ во чре́во Дѣ́вы сше́лъ є҆сѝ до́ждь Хрⷭ҇тѐ, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ ка́пли на зе́млю ка́плющыѧ, Є҆ѳїо́пїа и҆ Ѳарсі́съ и҆ а҆раві́тстїи ѻ҆́строви же, Савва̀, Ми́дѡвъ всю̀ зе́млю держа́щїи припадо́ша тебѣ̀ Сп҃се, сла́ва си́лѣ твое́й Го́споди.
items.english_cohort_translation: As rain upon the fleece, O Christ, Thou didst come down into the Virgin’s womb, and as drops falling upon the earth; and Ethiopia, and Tarshish, and the Arabian isles, Sheba, and they that hold the whole land of the Medes fell down before Thee, O Savior: Glory to Thy power, O Lord!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ро́да человѣ́ча ѡ҆бновле́нїе, дре́вле поѧ̀ пррⷪ́къ А҆ввакꙋ́мъ предвозвѣща́етъ, ви́дѣти неизрече́ннѡ сподо́бився ѻ҆́бразъ: мла́дый младе́нецъ бо и҆зъ горы̀ Дѣ́вы и҆зы́де, люде́й во ѡ҆бновле́нїе Сло́во.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́венъ произы́де человѣ́кѡмъ вы́шнїй, во́лею пло́ть прїи́мъ ѿ Дѣ́вы, ꙗ҆́дъ ѡ҆чи́стити ѕмі́евы главы̀: приводѧ̀ всѧ̑ къ свѣ́тꙋ живоно́сномꙋ, Бг҃ъ сы́й, ѿ вра́тъ безсо́лнечныхъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Equal to men came forth the Most High, willingly taking flesh from the Virgin, to purge the poison of the serpent's head, bringing all from sunless gates unto the life-bearing light, being God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆зы́цы и҆́же дре́вле тлѣ́ю погруже́ни, па́губы ѕѣлѡ̀ вра́жїѧ ᲂу҆бѣжа́вше, возно́сѧтъ рꙋ́ки съ похва́льными пѣ́сньми, є҆ди́наго чтꙋ́ще Хрⷭ҇та̀, ꙗ҆́кѡ ми́лостивнѡ прише́дшаго.
items.english_cohort_translation: The nations that of old were sunken in corruption, having wholly escaped the ruin of the enemy, lift up their hands with songs of praise, honoring Christ alone, as One Who has come in mercy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆зъ ко́рене и҆зра́стши І҆ессе́ева Дѣ́во, ᲂу҆ста́вы прешла̀ є҆сѝ человѣ́ческагѡ сꙋщества̀: О҆́ч҃ее ро́ждши превѣ́чное Сло́во, ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃говолѝ са́мъ запеча́таннꙋю ᲂу҆тро́бꙋ пройтѝ, и҆стоща́нїемъ стра́ннымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having sprung from the root of Jesse, O Virgin, thou hast passed beyond the bounds of human nature, having borne the Father's eternal Word, as He Himself was pleased to pass through a sealed womb by a strange emptying.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь є҃ — І҆рмо́съ: Бо́гъ сы́й ми́ра, О҆ц҃ъ щедро́тъ, вели́кагѡ совѣ́та твоегѡ̀ а҆́гг҃ла, ми́ръ подава́юща посла́лъ є҆сѝ на́мъ: тѣ́мъ бг҃оразꙋ́мїѧ къ свѣ́ту наста́вльшесѧ, ѿ но́щи ᲂу҆́тренююще, славосло́вимъ тѧ̀ человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 5. Heirmos:*[^174] Being the God of peace and Father of compassions, Thou hast sent unto us the Angel of Thy Great Counsel, Who grants peace; therefore, guided unto the light of divine knowledge, waking early out of the night, we glorify Thee, O Lover of mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ рабѣ́хъ ке́саревымъ повелѣ́нїемъ написа́тисѧ поко́рьсѧ: и҆ на́съ рабы̑ сꙋ́щыѧ, врага̀ и҆ грѣха̀, свободи́лъ є҆сѝ Хрⷭ҇тѐ, ве́сь же по на́мъ ѡ҆бнища́въ: и҆ пе́рстнагѡ ѿ самогѡ̀ є҆дине́нїа и҆ ѡ҆бще́нїа бг҃осодѣ́лалъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Submitting to be enrolled among servants by the decree of Caesar, Thou hast set us free who were the slaves of the enemy and of sin, O Christ; and becoming wholly poor according to our condition, from the very union and communion Thou hast made earthly man divine.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѐ Дѣ́ва ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле речѐ, во чре́вѣ прїе́мши родила̀ є҆́сть Бо́га вочеловѣ́чшасѧ, и҆ пребыва́етъ Дѣ́ва, є҆ѧ́же ра́ди примири́вшесѧ Бг҃ꙋ грѣ́шнїи, Бц҃ꙋ сꙋ́щꙋю вои́стиннꙋ вѣ́рнїи воспои́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Behold, as it was said of old, the Virgin, having conceived in her womb, has given birth to God incarnate, and remains a Virgin; reconciled through her to God, let us sinners, the faithful, praise her as truly the Mother of God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆зъ но́щи дѣ́лъ ѡ҆мраче́нныѧ пре́лести, ѡ҆чище́нїе на́мъ Хрⷭ҇тѐ бо́дреннѡ, ны́нѣ соверша́ющымъ пѣ́снь ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃годѣ́телю прїидѝ, подава́ѧй ᲂу҆до́бну стезю̀, по не́йже востека́юще, ѡ҆брѧ́щемъ сла́вꙋ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лю́тую враждꙋ̀ ю҆́же къ на́мъ Влⷣка ѿсѣка́ѧ па́ки, плотски́мъ прише́ствїемъ: да держа́щаго разрꙋши́тъ дꙋшетлѣ́ющаго; мі́ръ сочета́ѧ съ невеще́ственными сꙋществы̀: положи́въ пристꙋ́пна, ро́ждшаго тва́ри.
items.english_cohort_translation: Cutting off again the cruel enmity against us by Thy coming in the flesh, O Master, that Thou mightest destroy the soul-destroying ruler, uniting the world with the immaterial essences, Thou hast made the Parent accessible to creation.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Лю́дїе ви́дѣша дре́вле ѡ҆мраче́ннїи, по дне́хъ свѣ́тъ вы́шнїѧ свѣ́тлости: ꙗ҆зы́ки же Бг҃ꙋ наслѣ́дїе Сн҃ъ прино́ситъ, подаѧ̀ та́мѡ неизрече́нную благода́ть, и҆дѣ́же множа́йшій процвѣтѐ грѣ́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The people that of old were darkened have seen after days the light of the brightness from on high; and as an inheritance unto God the Son brings the Gentiles, granting ineffable grace there where sin abounded most.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь ѕ҃ — І҆рмо́съ: И҆зъ ᲂу҆тро́бы І҆ѡ́нꙋ младе́нца и҆зблева̀ морскі́й ѕвѣ́рь, ꙗ҆кова̀ прїѧ́тъ: въ Дѣ́вꙋ же все́льшеесѧ Сло́во про́йде сохрани́вшее нетлѣ́ннꙋ; є҆гѡ́же бо не пострада̀ и҆стлѣ́нїѧ, ро́ждшꙋю сохранѝ неврежде́нну.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos:*[^176] The sea beast spewed forth Jonah from its belly like a babe, just as it had received him; and the Word, having dwelt within the Virgin and taken flesh, came forth, preserving her incorrupt; for suffering no corruption Himself, He kept her who bore Him unharmed.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїи́де вопло́щьсѧ Хрⷭ҇то́съ Бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆зъ чре́ва є҆го́же О҆ц҃ъ пре́жде денни́цы ражда́етъ: правле́нїа же держа̀ пречи́стыхъ си́лъ, въ ꙗ҆́слѣхъ ско́тїихъ возлежи́тъ, и҆ пелена́ми повива́етсѧ, разрѣша́етъ же многоплете́нныѧ плени́цы прегрѣше́ній.
items.english_cohort_translation: Incarnate came Christ our God, Whom the Father begat from the womb before the morning star; and holding the governance of the all-pure hosts, He lies in a manger of dumb beasts and is wrapped in swaddling bands, yet He looses the tangled bonds of transgressions.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ю҆́но и҆зъ А҆да́ма, ѻ҆троча̀ смѣше́нїа, роди́сѧ сы́нъ, и҆ вѣ̑рнымъ даде́сѧ, бꙋ́дꙋщагѡ вѣ́ка се́й є҆́сть О҆ц҃ъ и҆ нача́льникъ: и҆ нарица́етсѧ вели́кагѡ совѣ́та А҆́гг҃лъ; се́й крѣ́покъ Бг҃ъ є҆́сть, и҆ держа́й ѻ҆́бластїю всю̀ тва́рь.
items.english_cohort_translation: As a young Child from Adam, a Son is born of our mingled nature and given unto the faithful; He is the Father and Ruler of the age to come, and is called the Angel of Great Counsel; He is the mighty God, holding dominion over all creation.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́же бѣ̀ и҆спе́рва ᲂу҆ Бг҃а, Бо́гъ Сло́во, ны́нѣ ᲂу҆твержда́етъ немощно́е дре́вле, ви́дѣвъ сохрани́ти, є҆́же по на́мъ сꙋщество̀, и҆́мже себѐ вторы́мъ ѡ҆бще́нїемъ а҆́бїе проѧвлѧ́ѧ страсте́й свобо́дное.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Грѧде́тъ на́съ ра́ди, и҆зъ А҆враа́млихъ чре́слъ, темнопа́дшыѧ во мра́цѣ прегрѣше́ній, сны̑ воздви́гнꙋти до́лꙋ пони́кшихъ: и҆́же во свѣ́тѣ ѡ҆бита́ѧй, и҆ ꙗ҆́слѣхъ, чрезъ достоѧ́нїе, ны́нѣ благоволи́въ въ человѣ́ческое спасенїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: For our sake He comes from Abraham's loins to raise up as sons those who had fallen darkly in the gloom of sins, bowed down to the earth; He Who dwells in light is now well pleased, through His condescension, to be laid in a manger for the salvation of mankind.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, Гла́съ г҃, Подо́бенъ. Дѣ́ва дне́сь пресꙋ́щественнаго ражда́етъ, и҆ землѧ̀ верте́пъ непристꙋ́пномꙋ прино́ситъ, а҆́гг҃ли съ па́стырьми славосло́вѧтъ, волсвѝ же со ѕвѣздо́ю пꙋтеше́ствꙋютъ: на́съ бо ра́ди роди́сѧ, ѻ҆троча̀ мла́до, превѣ́чный Бг҃ъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3. Automelon (Самоподо́бенъ):*[^178] Today the Virgin gives birth to the Transcendent One, and the earth offers a cave to the Inaccessible; angels with shepherds give glory, and Magi journey with a star: for unto us is born a young Child, God before the ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ. Є҆де́мъ Виѳлеє́мъ ѿве́рзе, прїиди́те ви́димъ. пи́щꙋ въ та́йнѣ ѡ҆брѣтохо́мъ: прїиди́те прїи́мемъ, сꙋ́щаѧ ра́йскаѧ вну́трь верте́па: та́мѡ ꙗ҆ви́сѧ ко́рень ненапое́нъ, прозѧба́ѧ ѿпꙋще́нїе: та́мѡ ѡ҆брѣ́тесѧ кла́дѧзь неископа́нъ, и҆зъ негѡ́же Дв҃дъ пи́ти дре́вле возжада́сѧ; та́мѡ Дѣ́ва ро́ждши млⷣнца, жа́ждꙋ ᲂу҆ста́ви а҆́бїе А҆да́мовꙋ и҆ Дв҃довꙋ; сегѡ̀ ра́ди къ немꙋ̀ и҆́демъ гдѣ̀ роди́сѧ, ѻ҆троча̀ мла́до превѣ́чный Бо́гъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:*[^179] Bethlehem has opened Eden, come, let us behold; we have found delight in secret: come, let us receive the things of paradise within the cave; there an unwatered root has appeared, budding forth remission; there an undug well is found, whereof David of old longed to drink; there the Virgin, having given birth to an Infant, straightway quenched the thirst of Adam and David; therefore let us go unto Him where He is born: a young Child, God before the ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́стырїе свирѧ́юще, ᲂу҆жа́сно свѣтоѧвле́нїе полꙋчи́ша: сла́ва бо Гдⷭ҇нѧ ѡ҆блиста̀ и҆́хъ, и҆ а҆́гг҃лъ: воспо́йте, вопїѧ̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ роди́сѧ Хрⷭ҇то́съ, ѻ҆тє́цъ Бг҃ъ бл҃гослове́нный.
items.english_cohort_translation: The shepherds playing on their pipes received an awe-inspiring manifestation of light; for the glory of the Lord shone round about them, and the angel cried out: Sing, for Christ is born, the blessed God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Внеза́пꙋ съ сло́вомъ а҆́гг҃ловымъ нбⷭ҇наѧ вѡ́инства, сла́ва — вопїѧ́хꙋ, Бг҃ꙋ въ вы́шнихъ, на землѝ ми́ръ, въ чл҃вѣ́цѣхъ благоволе́нїе: Хрⷭ҇то́съ возсїѧ̀, ѻ҆тє́цъ Бг҃ъ бл҃гослове́нный.
items.english_cohort_translation: Suddenly with the word of the angel, the heavenly hosts cried aloud: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will among men! Christ has shone forth, the blessed God of our fathers!

items.english_cohort_translation: What is this saying? said the shepherds: Having gone, let us see that which is come to pass, the divine Christ; and having reached Bethlehem, with her who bore Him they bowed down, singing: Blessed art Thou, O God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слꙋги̑ ᲂу҆́бѡ неи́стовнѡ попала́етъ, спаса́етъ же всепала́щаѧ со стра́хомъ ю҆́ныѧ, седмочи́сленнымъ разже́нїемъ возвы́шена: и҆́хже вѣнча̀ пла́мень, незави́стнѡ, Гдⷭ҇ꙋ подаю́щꙋ бл҃гоче́стїѧ ра́ди ро́сꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Fiercely it consumed the servants, but preserved the youths with reverence, the all-devouring furnace heightened by a sevenfold burning; whom the flame crowned, the Lord bounteously granting dew for their piety's sake.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Помо́щниче Хрⷭ҇тѐ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ, проти́вное гада́нїе, воплоще́нїе неизглаго́ланное и҆мѣ́ѧй, посрами́лъ є҆сѝ: бога́тство ѡ҆боже́нїаносѧ́й, вообра́жсѧ ны́нѣ, є҆гѡ́же ра́ди ᲂу҆пова́нїемъ, свы́ше въ преиспо́днїй прїидо́хомъ мра́къ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Christ, Helper of men, possessing an ineffable incarnation, Thou hast put to shame the adversary's boast; bearing the riches of deification, Thou hast now taken form, therefore, through hope from on high, we have come into the nether darkness.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѕлѣ̀ неᲂу҆держа́ннѡ возвыша́емый, нече́стнѡ бѣсѧ́щїйсѧ ѿ развраще́нїа мі́ра, низложи́лъ є҆сѝ всемо́щнѣ грѣ́хъ, ꙗ҆́же привлечѐ пре́жде: дне́сь же ѿ сѣ́тей спаса́еши, вопло́щьсѧ во́лею бл҃годѣ́телю.
items.english_cohort_translation: The sin which was wickedly and unrestrainedly exalted, raging impiously through the perversion of the world, which drew us down of old, Thou hast almighty overthrown; and today from the snares Thou savest us, incarnate of Thine own will, O Benefactor.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь и҃ — І҆рмо́съ: Чꙋ́да преесте́ственнагѡ, росода́тельнаѧ и҆зобразѝ пе́щь ѻ҆́бразъ, не бо ꙗ҆́же прїѧ́тъ пали́тъ ю҆́ныѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ нижѐ ѻ҆́гнь бж҃ества̀ Дѣ́вы, въ ню́же вни́де ᲂу҆тро́бꙋ, тѣ́мъ воспѣва́юще воспое́мъ: да бл҃гослови́тъ тва́рь всѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 8. Heirmos:*[^182] The dew-bearing furnace portrayed the type of a supernatural marvel; for it burned not the youths whom it had received, just as the fire of the Godhead burned not the Virgin's womb into which it entered; therefore, singing, let us sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Влече́тъ Вавѷлѡ́на дщѝ, ѻ҆́трокы плѣне́нныѧ Дв҃довы ѿ Сїѡ́на къ себѣ̀: дароно́сцы же сле́тъ волхвы̀ дѣ́ти, Дв҃довѣ бг҃прїѧ́тнѣй дще́ри молѧ́щыѧсѧ; тѣ́мъ воспѣва́юще воспое́мъ: да бл҃гослови́тъ тва́рь всѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_cohort_translation: The daughter of Babylon draws unto herself the captive children of David from Zion; but she sends the Magi youth bearing gifts, entreating the God-receiving daughter of David; therefore, singing, let us sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆рга́ны, ᲂу҆клони́ша плаче́вныѧ пѣ́сни, не поѧ́хꙋ бо въ землѝ чꙋжде́й ѻ҆́троци Сїѡ́новы: вавѷлѡ́нскꙋю же разрѣша́етъ ле́сть всю̀, и҆ мꙋсікі́йскїѧ соста́вы, въ Виѳлеє́мѣ возсїѧ́въ Хрїсто́съ; тѣ́мъ воспѣва́юще воспои́мъ: да бл҃гослови́тъ тва́рь всѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.
items.english_cohort_translation: Instruments turned aside mournful songs, for the sons of Zion sang not in a strange land; but Christ, having shone forth in Bethlehem, looses all the deceit of Babylon and musical harmonies; therefore, singing, let us sing: Let all creation bless the Lord, and exalt Him above all unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Кори́сти Вавѷлѡ́нъ ца́рства Сїѡ́на, и҆ плѣне́ное бога́тство прїѧ́тъ: сокро́вища же Хрⷭ҇то́съ въ Сїѡ́нъ сегѡ̀, и҆ цр҃ѝ ѕвѣздо́ю наставля́ѧ ѕвѣздоблюсти́тели влече́тъ; тѣ́мъ воспѣва́юще воспои́мъ: да благослови́тъ тва́рь всѧ̀ Гдⷭ҇а, и҆ превозно́ситъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́кы.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́гꙋбы ᲂу҆бѣжа́вши, є҆́же ѡ҆божи́тисѧ пре́лестїю, непреста́ннѡ пое́тъ и҆злїя́вшагосѧ Сло́ва, ю҆́ношески всѧ̀ съ тре́петомъ тва́рь, несла́внꙋ хвалꙋ̀ боѧ́щисѧ прино́ситъ: тлѣ́нна сꙋ́щи, а҆́ще и҆ мꙋ́дрѣ терпѧ́ше.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having escaped the destruction of seeking deification through deceit, all creation unceasingly praises the Word Who emptied Himself, and in youthlike manner with trembling, in fear offers an inglorious praise, being corruptible, even though wisely enduring.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Грѧде́ши заблꙋ́ждшее на па́жить ѡ҆браща́ѧ, цвѣтотво́рнꙋю, и҆зъ пꙋсты́нныхъ холмѡ́въ, ꙗ҆зы́кѡвъ воста́нїе, человѣ́ческое є҆стество̀, си́лꙋ нꙋ́жнꙋю человѣкоꙋбі́йци ᲂу҆гаси́ти: мꙋ́жъ же ꙗ҆ви́всѧ и҆ Бг҃ъ промышле́нїемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou comest turning the strayed unto the flower-bearing pasture from the desert hills, to quell the violent power of the manslayer over the uprising of the nations, human nature; having appeared as man and God by providence.

items.english_cohort_translation: A strange and most glorious mystery do I behold: the cave is heaven; the Virgin, the Cherubic Throne; the manger, the receptacle in which Christ God, Whom nothing can contain, has reclined; Whom singing, we magnify.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рождество твое, Хрте Бже нашъ, возсїя мїрови свѣтъ разума: въ немъ бо звѣздамъ служащїи, звѣздою обучахуся, тебѣ кланятися солнцу правды, и тебе вѣдѣти въ высоты востока: Гди, слава тебѣ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy Nativity, O Christ our God, has shone the light of knowledge upon the world; for thereby those who worshiped the stars were taught by a star to adore Thee, the Sun of Righteousness, and to know Thee, the Dayspring from on high: O Lord, glory to Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слава въ вышнихъ Бгу, и на земли миръ, днесь воспрїемлетъ Виѳлеемъ, сѣдящаго приснѡ съ Ѻцемъ; днесь аггли млнца рожденнаго бголѣпнѡ славословятъ: Слава въ вышнихъ Бгу, и на земли миръ, въ человѣцѣхъ бл҃говоленїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace! Today Bethlehem receives Him Who sits ever with the Father; today the angels divinely glorify the newborn Babe: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will among men!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гд҃и въ Виѳлее́мѣ прише́дъ, въ верте́пъ всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ: не́бо пр҃то́лъ и҆мѣ́ѧ, въ ꙗ҆́слѣхъ положи́лсѧ є҆сѝ: є҆го́же вѡ́инства ѡ҆кружа́ютъ а҆́гг҃лъ, па́стыремъ снизше́лъ є҆сѝ, да спасе́ши ꙗ҆́кѡ милосе́рдъ ро́дъ на́шъ, сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Lord, coming to Bethlehem, Thou didst dwell in a cave; having heaven as Thy throne, Thou wast laid in a manger; whom the angelic hosts surround, unto the shepherds Thou didst condescend, that Thou mightest save our race as Thou art compassionate: glory to Thee![^235]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ка́кѡ и҆зреку̀ вели́кое та́инство? безпло́тный воплоща́етсѧ, сло́во ѡ҆дебелѣва́етъ: неви́димый ви́дитсѧ, и҆ неосѧза́емый ѡ҆сѧза́етсѧ: и҆ безна́чалный начина́етсѧ: Сн҃ъ Бж҃їй, Сн҃ъ чл҃вѣ́чь быва́етъ: І҆и҃съ Хрⷭ҇то́съ вчера̀ и҆ дне́сь, то́йже и҆ во вѣ́кы.
items.english_cohort_translation: How shall I declare the great mystery? The Incorporeal takes flesh; the Word becomes physical; the Invisible is seen, and the Intangible is touched; and the Unoriginate begins; the Son of God becomes the Son of Man: Jesus Christ, yesterday and today, the same also unto the ages.[^237]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пра́зднуетъ дне́сь съ весе́лїемъ Це́рковь па́мѧть твою̀ цѣлому́дренный І҆ѡ́сифе, Хрⷭ҇ту̀ Бо́гу возлю́бленне, Ма́тере є҆гѡ̀ О҆бру́чниче, досто́йнѡ бо тѧ̀ ѡ҆брѣ́те себѣ̀ на землѝ пита́телѧ и҆ храни́телѧ О҆́ч҃ее превѣ́чнее Сло́во, въ ложесна́хъ дѣви́ческихъ неизрече́ннѡ вопло́щшеесѧ: є҆му́же съ пречи́стою є҆гѡ̀ Ма́терїю, твое́ю же пренепоро́чною О҆бру́чницею, моли́сѧ, да спасе́тъ ду́ши на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the Church celebrates with gladness thy memory, O chaste Joseph, beloved of Christ God, Betrothed of His Mother; for the Father's pre-eternal Word, Who was ineffably incarnate in the virginal womb, worthily found thee to be for Himself on earth a nourisher and guardian: pray unto Him, together with His most pure Mother and thine all-immaculate Betrothed, that He may save our souls.[^242]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оотца̀ всѝ восхва́лимъ* Дв҃да царѧ̀,* и҆зъ негѡ́ бо про́йде же́злъ Дв҃а;* и҆ и҆зъ неѧ̀ возсїѧ̀ цвѣ́тъ Хрїсто́съ,* и҆ А҆да́ма со Є҆́вою ѿ тлѝ воззва̀* ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гоутро́бенъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us all praise the Ancestor of God, David the King, for from him came forth the rod, the Virgin, and from her blossomed forth Christ, and He recalled Adam with Eve from corruption, for He is compassionate.[^252]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Проро́чєскаѧ пророче́нїѧ ви́дѣ въ ста́рости* ꙗ҆́вѣ І҆ѡ́сифъ ѡ҆бру́чникъ,* проѧвле́ннѡ и҆сполнѧ́ємаѧ,* ѡ҆бруче́нїе вои́стинну стра́нное:* ѿкрове́нїе а҆́гг҃лы прїе́мъ, Бг҃у сла́ва вопїю́щихъ,* на зе́млю ми́ръ низпосла́вшему.
items.english_cohort_translation: Joseph the Betrothed in his old age clearly saw the prophetic proclamations visibly fulfilled, a truly strange betrothal, having received revelation by angels who cry: Glory to God, Who has sent down peace upon the earth![^253]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бра́та Гд҃нѧ всѝ восхва́лимъ,* ꙗ҆́кѡ свѧти́телѧ су́ща:* муче́нїемъ же па́ки просїѧ́вша до́блественнѣ;* є҆гѡ́же мл҃твами І҆и҃се Бж҃е на́шъ,* въ верте́пѣ и҆ въ пелена́хъ пови́выйсѧ,* спасѝ всѧ̑ пою́щыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us all praise the Brother of the Lord, as being a hierarch, and again having shone forth valiantly by martyrdom; by whose prayers, O Jesus our God, Who wast swaddled in swaddling clothes in the cave, save all who sing unto Thee.[^254]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́мѧть соверша́емъ, Дв҃да, и҆ І҆а́кѡва, бл҃гочести́выхъ: царѧ̀ прⷪ҇ро́ка, и҆ а҆по́стола, пе́рвагѡ є҆пі́скопа; тѣ́хъ бо оу҆че́ньми ле́сти и҆зба́вльшесѧ, Хрⷭ҇та̀ славосло́вимъ ѿ Дв҃ы возсїѧ́вшагосѧ и҆ вопло́щшагосѧ, є҆́же спастѝ ду́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: We celebrate the memory of the pious David and James, the prophet-king and the apostle, the first bishop; for having been delivered from deception by their teachings, we glorify Christ Who shone forth and was incarnate of the Virgin, that He might save our souls.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃ще́нныхъ па́мѧть, и҆ царе́й держа́ва, и҆ весе́лїе бы́сть рождество̀ твоѐ: и҆ въ не́мъ хва́лѧщесѧ гл҃емъ: О҆́ч҃е на́шъ и҆́же є҆сѝ на небесѣ́хъ, да ст҃и́тсѧ и҆́мѧ твоѐ чл҃вѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thy Nativity has become the memory of the hallowed, the dominion of kings, and gladness; and boasting in it, we say: Our Father Who art in the heavens, hallowed be Thy name, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь неви́димое є҆стество̀, человѣ́кѡмъ ѿ Дѣ́вы совокуплѧ́етсѧ, дне́сь безмѣ́рное сꙋщество̀, въ Виѳлее́мѣ пелена́ми ѡ҆бвива́етсѧ, дне́сь Бо́гъ ѕвѣздо́ю волхвы̀ въ поклоне́нїе приво́дитъ; превозвѣща́ѧ своѐ трїдне́вное погребе́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ зла́тѣ и҆ сми́рнѣ и҆ лїва́нѣ, є҆мꙋ́же пое́мъ: воплоти́выйсѧ ѿ Дѣ́вы Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е, спасѝ ду́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the invisible nature is united to men from the Virgin; today the immeasurable essence in Bethlehem is wrapped in swaddling clothes; today God by a star leads the Magi unto worship, prefiguring His three-day burial as in gold, myrrh, and frankincense, unto Whom we sing: O Christ God incarnate of the Virgin, save our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Вознесы́йсѧ на кре́стъ во́лею, тезоимени́тому твоему̀ но́вому жи́тельству, щедро́ты твоѧ̑ да́руй Хрⷭ҇тѐ Бж҃е: возвеселѝ си́лою твое́ю, благовѣ́рнаго і҆мпера́тора на́шего побѣ́ды даѧ̀ є҆му̀ на сопоста́ты, посо́бїе и҆му́щему твоѐ, ѻ҆ру́жїе ми́ра, непобѣди́мую побѣ́ду.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou Who of Thine own will wast lifted up upon the Cross, O Christ God, grant Thy compassions unto Thy new commonwealth named after Thee; make glad our right-believing Emperor by Thy power, granting him victories over adversaries, having Thine alliance, an armor of peace, an invincible trophy.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Предста́тельнице стра́шнаѧ и҆ непосты́днаѧ, не пре́зри Бл҃га́ѧ моли́твъ на́шихъ, всепѣ́таѧ Бцⷣе оу҆твердѝ правосла́вныхъ жи́телство и҆ спасѝ, и҆̀мже повелѣ́ла є҆сѝ держа́вствовати, и҆ пода́ждь и҆̀мъ съ небесѐ побѣ́ду, занѐ родила̀ є҆сѝ Бг҃а, є҆ди́на Бл҃гослове́ннаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O awesome and unashamed Mediatress, despise not our prayers, O good, all-hymned Theotokos: establish the commonwealth of the Orthodox, and save those whom thou hast commanded to rule, and grant them victory from heaven, for thou didst bear God, O only blessed one.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆и҃су ро́ждшусѧ въ Виѳлее́мѣ І҆уде́йстѣмъ, тва́рь просвѣти́сѧ позна́вши зижди́телѧ: оу҆диви́шасѧ а҆́гг҃лстїи ли́ци, зрѧ́ще Вл҃ку на землѝ зра́къ ра́бїй прїе́мша су́ща; Сла́ва вопло́щшемусѧ Бг҃у, сла́ва рожде́нному на землѝ: сла́ва бл҃говоли́вшему спастѝ ро́дъ на́шъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: When Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea, creation was enlightened, having recognized the Creator; the angelic choirs were amazed, beholding the Master on earth having assumed the form of a servant: Glory to God Who was incarnate; glory to Him Who was born on earth; glory to Him Who was well pleased to save our race![^299]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Что̀ чуди́шисѧ Марїа́мъ? что̀ оу҆жаса́етъ є҆́же въ тебѣ̀? ꙗ҆́кѡ безлѣ́тна Сн҃а въ лѣ́та роди́хъ, речѐ: рожде́ннагѡ зача́тїѧ не навы́кши, безму́жна є҆́смь, и҆ ка́кѡ рожду̀ Сн҃а? безсѣ́менно рожде́нїе кто̀ ви́дѣ? и҆дѣ́же бо Бо́гъ хо́щетъ, побѣжда́етсѧ є҆стества̀ чи́нъ, ꙗ҆́коже пи́шетъ: Хрїсто́съ роди́сѧ, пре́жде па́дшій возста́вити ѻ҆́бразъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Why art thou amazed, O Mary? What strikes awe at that which is in thee? Because I gave birth to the timeless Son in time, she said; having not learned the conception of childbirth, I am unwedded, and how shall I bear a Son? Who has seen a seedless birth? For where God wills, the order of nature is overcome, as it is written: Christ is born, to raise up the image that was fallen aforetime.[^301]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆́косъ: Невоздѣ́ланный гро́здъ возрасти́вшаѧ, та́йный вїногра́де: ꙗ҆́кѡ на вѣ́твїихъ на ѡ҆б̾ѧ́тїихъ ноша́ше, и҆ гла́ше: ты̀ є҆сѝ пло́дъ мо́й; ты̀ є҆сѝ жи́знь моѧ̀; ѿне́лѣже позна́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆ є҆́же бѣ́хъ, є҆́смъ: ты̀ мо́й Бо́гъ: печа́ть бо дѣ́вства моегѡ̀ зрѧ́щи неразруши́му, проповѣ́дую тѧ̀ непрело́жнаго сло́ва пло́ть бы́вша; не вѣ́мъ сѣ́мене, вѣ́мъ тѧ̀ рѣши́телѧ тлѣ́нїѧ: чиста̀ бо є҆́смь, тебѣ̀ прише́дшу и҆зъ менѐ, ꙗ҆́коже бо ѡ҆брѣ́тъ, ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ оу҆тро́бу мою̀, зрѧ́щи ю҆̀ цѣ́лу; сегѡ̀ ра́ди сликовству́етъ всѧ̀ тва́рь вопїю́щи мнѣ̀, ра́дуйсѧ бл҃года́тнаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:*[^309] Thou who didst bud forth the uncultivated Cluster of Grapes, O mystical vineyard, bore Him in thine arms as on branches, and said: Thou art my Fruit; Thou art my Life; since I knew that I also remain what I was: Thou art my God; for beholding the seal of my virginity unbroken, I proclaim Thee, the immutable Word, having become flesh; I know no seed, I know Thee as the Looser of corruption; for I am pure, since Thou didst come forth from me, for as Thou didst find my womb, so hast Thou left it, beholding it intact; therefore all creation rejoices together, crying unto me: Rejoice, O Full of Grace![^310]

items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice, ye righteous; be glad, ye heavens; leap for joy, ye mountains, for Christ is born! The Virgin sits resembling the cherubim, bearing in her bosom God the Word incarnate; the shepherds marvel at Him Who was born; the Magi bring gifts unto the Master; the angels singing say: Incomprehensible Lord, glory to Thee![^315]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бцⷣе Дѣ́во ро́ждшаѧ Спа́са, оу҆праздни́ла є҆сѝ пе́рвую клѧ́тву Є҆́ѵину; ꙗ҆́кѡ ма́ти была̀ є҆сѝ бл҃говоле́нїѧ О҆ч҃а, носѧ́щи въ нѣ́дрѣхъ Бж҃їе Сло́во воплоще́нное: не терпи́тъ та́йна и҆спыта́нїѧ; вѣ́рою є҆ди́ною сїю̀ всѝ сла́вимъ, зову́ще съ тобо́ю, и҆ гл҃юще: неизрече́нне Гд҃и сла́ва тебѣ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O Virgin Theotokos, who didst bear the Savior, thou hast abolished the first curse of Eve; for thou wast the Mother of the Father's good pleasure, bearing in thy bosom God the Word incarnate; the mystery tolerates no searching out; by faith alone do we all glorify it, crying out with thee, and saying: Ineffable Lord, glory to Thee![^316]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прїиди́те воспои́мъ Ма́терь Спа́сову, по рождествѣ̀ па́ки ꙗ҆́вльшуюсѧ Дѣ́ву; ра́дуйсѧ гра́де ѡ҆душевле́нный царѧ̀ и҆ Бг҃а, въ не́мже Хрⷭ҇то́съ пожи́въ спасе́нїе содѣ́ла; съ Гаврїи́ломъ воспое́мъ, съ па́стырьми просла́вимъ, зову́ще: Бцⷣе молѝ и҆зъ тебѐ воплоще́ннаго спасти́сѧ на́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, let us sing unto the Mother of the Savior, who after childbearing appeared again a Virgin: Rejoice, O ensouled city of the King and God, in which Christ dwelt and wrought salvation; with Gabriel let us sing, with the shepherds let us give glory, crying: O Theotokos, pray unto Him Who was incarnate of thee, that we may be saved![^317]

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь неви́димое є҆стество̀, чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ ѿ Дѣ́вы совокуплѧ́етсѧ: дне́сь безмѣ́рное сꙋщество̀, въ Виѳлее́мѣ пелена́ми ѡ҆бвива́етсѧ: дне́сь Бг҃ъ ѕвѣздо́ю волхвы̀ въ поклоне́нїе приво́дитъ, превозвѣща́ѧ своѐ трїдне́вное погребе́нїе, ꙗ҆́кѡ въ зла́тѣ и҆ сми́рнѣ и҆ лїва́нѣ, є҆мꙋ́же пое́мъ: воплоти́выйсѧ ѿ Дѣ́вы Хрїстѐ Бж҃е спасѝ ду́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today the invisible nature is united to men from the Virgin; today the immeasurable essence in Bethlehem is wrapped in swaddling clothes; today God by a star leads the Magi unto worship, prefiguring His three-day burial as in gold, myrrh, and frankincense, unto Whom we sing: O Christ God incarnate of the Virgin, save our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дне́сь Хрїсто́съ въ Виѳлеє́мѣ ражда́етсѧ ѿ Дѣ́вы: дне́сь безна́чальный начина́етсѧ, и҆ сло́во воплоща́етсѧ; си́лы небе́сныѧ ра́дуютсѧ, и҆ землѧ̀ съ чл҃вѣ́кы весели́тсѧ; волсвѝ Влⷣцѣ да́ры прино́сѧтъ; па́стырїе рожде́нному дивѧ́тсѧ; мы́ же непреста́ннѡ вопїе́мъ: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃у, и҆ на землѝ ми́ръ въ человѣ́цѣхъ бл҃говоле́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Today Christ is born in Bethlehem of the Virgin; today He Who is without beginning begins to be, and the Word becomes incarnate; the heavenly hosts rejoice, and the earth with mankind makes merry; the Magi offer gifts to the Master; the shepherds marvel at Him Who was born; and we unceasingly cry aloud: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will among men!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Воспою̀ тебѣ̀ Гдⷭи Бж҃е мо́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆зве́лъ є҆сѝ лю́ди, и҆зъ рабо́ты є҆гѵ́петскїѧ, покры́лъ же є҆сѝ колесни́цы Фараѡ́новы и҆ си́лу.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ро́ждшагосѧ пло́тїю, ѿ Дѣ́вы безъ сѣ́мене Хрⷭта̀ Бг҃а, со а҆́гг҃лы всѝ воспое́мъ: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бг҃у, взыва́юще.
items.english_cohort_translation: Let us all with the angels sing of Christ God Who was born in the flesh of the Virgin without seed, crying aloud: Glory to God in the highest!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всепра́зднственный, на́съ ра́ди и҆стощи́вшагѡсѧ вѣ́рнїи пра́здникъ, съ Дв҃домъ же и҆ І҆а́кѡвомъ, пѣ́сньми по достоѧ́нїю почти́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O faithful, with David and James let us worthily honor with hymns the all-festal feast of Him Who emptied Himself for our sake.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ жени́хъ ѿ черто́га, и҆зъ мт҃рнихъ ложе́снъ, Дв҃дъ речѐ Гдⷭу и҆зы́ти: є҆го́же ны́нѣ со І҆а́кѡвомъ воспое́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: As a bridegroom from his chamber, David said the Lord would come forth from the maternal womb; Whom now with James let us sing.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Съ волхвы̀ ро́ждшемꙋсѧ поклони́мсѧ, и҆ со а҆́гг҃лы и҆ І҆ѡ́сифомъ ликꙋ́имъ, бг҃олѣ́пнѡ взыва́юще: Сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Хрⷭтꙋ̀ Бг҃у.
items.english_cohort_translation: With the Magi let us worship Him Who was born, and with the angels and Joseph let us rejoice, crying out in a manner fitting for God: Glory in the highest to Christ God!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ца́рствꙋѧй всѣ́ми царьмѝ Хрїсто́съ, по пло́ти ѿ сѣ́мене, Дв҃дова рожде́йсѧ, и҆збра́ннаго І҆а́кѡва прїѧ́тъ бра́та, ꙗ҆́коже и҆зво́ли.
items.english_cohort_translation: Christ, reigning over all kings, being born according to the flesh from the seed of David, accepted chosen James as brother, even as He was pleased.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣ́лъ є҆сѝ на прⷭто́лѣ, ꙗ҆́коже клѧ́лсѧ є҆сѝ Влⷣко пррⷪ́кꙋ Дв҃ду, ѿ плода̀ чре́ва є҆гѡ̀ проше́дъ: І҆а́кѡвꙋ же цр҃кве пре́далъ є҆сѝ прⷭто́лъ Хрїстѐ.

items.english_cohort_translation: *Kontakion, Tone 3. items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: Неизрече́ннымъ совѣ́томъ ражда́етъ пло́тїю, безпло́тный: ѡ҆писꙋ́етсѧ ны́нѣ тѣ́ломъ, неѡпи́санный: и҆ спаса́етъ непрело́жнѡ ѻ҆́ба сꙋщества̀: нача́ло прїе́млетъ, и҆́же є҆стество́мъ, безнача́льный, и҆ є҆ди́нъ безлѣ́тенъ: зри́тсѧ младе́нецъ, сі́й всесоверше́нный: но́ситсѧ рꙋка́ми, носѧ́й всѧ́ческаѧ; тѣ́мже тогѡ̀ сро́дствомъ почте́нныѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ Бг҃ъ вѣнча́етъ свои́мъ рождество́мъ: ꙗ҆̀же прославлѧ́юще вѣ́рою, немо́лчнѡ вопїе́мъ: ще́дре спаса́й тебѐ чтꙋ́щыѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:*[^343] By ineffable counsel the Bodiless One is born in the flesh; the Uncircumscribed is now circumscribed in body; and He saves immutably both natures. He Who by nature is without beginning and alone timeless receives a beginning; He, the all-perfect, is seen as an infant; He Who upholds all things is borne in arms; therefore, as God He crowns by His Nativity those honored by kinship with Him; whom glorifying with faith, unceasingly we cry aloud: O Merciful One, save those who honor Thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́че сло́ва рождествꙋ̀ Бцⷣы Мр҃і́и, ли́цы а҆́гг҃лстїи дивѧ́шесѧ, І҆ѡ́сифꙋ вопїѧ́хꙋ: въ вы́шнихъ сла́ва, и҆ на землѝ ми́ръ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ро́ждшемꙋсѧ ѿ Дѣ́вы всѧ̀ тра́рь [sic; тва́рь] трепе́томъ послꙋжѝ: нб҃са̀ оу҆́бѡ ѕвѣздо́ю: землѧ̀ же ꙗ҆́слми: гора̀ верте́помъ: волсвѝ дармѝ: па́стырїе чꙋдесе́мъ: а҆́гг҃ли же сла́ва въ вы́шнихъ Бо́гꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: All creation served with trembling Him Who was born of the Virgin: the heavens with a star; the earth with a manger; the mountain with a cave; the Magi with gifts; the shepherds with wonders; and the angels with: Glory to God in the highest!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ца́рь ѿ па́стырей дре́вле оу҆́бѡ Дави́дъ бы́сть, ѿ колѣ́на же І҆ꙋ́дова и҆ цр҃кагѡ ты̀ І҆а́кѡве, па́стырь па́ствы показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ вопло́щшагѡсѧ, а҆́гнца вы́шнѧгѡ и҆ Сн҃а Бж҃їѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: David was indeed made a king from being a shepherd of old; and thou, O James, from the tribe of Judah and the royal tribe, wast shown forth as shepherd of the flock of Him Who was incarnate, the Lamb on high and the Son of God.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Виѳлеє́ме ны́нѣ весели́сѧ, гра́дъ бы́въ но́вагѡ Дв҃да: и҆ Сїѡ́не возвѣща́й цр҃квей старѣ́йшинство, ѻ҆́бщее весе́лїе, всѣ́хъ царѧ̀, и҆ тогѡ̀ оу҆го́дники ны́нѣ воспрїе́мши.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice now, O Bethlehem, having become the city of the new David; and Sion, proclaim the primacy of the churches, the common joy, having now received the King of all and His pleased servants!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Exapostilarion. Podoben: With the disciples (Съ оу҆ченикѝ взы́демъ):*[^348] With glorious James, the Brother of the Lord, let us sing of David the Ancestor of God, and divine Joseph the Betrothed of the Mother of God; for they served the divine Nativity of Christ in the city of Bethlehem in a manner fitting for God, with angels, Magi, and shepherds, singing a hymn to Him as God and Master.[^349]
